title: 1995 AMC 8 Problem 24
statement: In parallelogram \(ABCD,\) \(\overline{DE}\) is the altitude to the base \(\overline{AB}\) and \(\overline{DF}\) is the altitude to the base \(\overline{BC}.\) (Both pictures represent the same parallelogram.) If \(DC = 12,\) \(EB = 4,\) and \(DE = 6,\) then \(DF =\)

solutions.text:
Since \(AB = DC = 12,\) we get \(AE = 12 - 4 = 8.\) In right triangle \(ADE,\) \(AD = \sqrt{8^2 + 6^2} = 10,\) so \(BC = AD = 10.\)

The area is \(AB \cdot DE = 12 \cdot 6 = 72,\) and also \(BC \cdot DF = 10 \cdot DF.\) So \(DF = \dfrac{72}{10} = 7.2.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: Opposite sides are equal, so \(AB = 12;\) find \(AE,\) then \(AD\) with the right triangle \(ADE\)
The area equals base \(\times\) height for either base: \(AB \cdot DE = BC \cdot DF\)
